intent: Center the source packet on the table in place of a gavel. Authority in this forum comes from examined evidence rather than judicial spectacle. Keep the paper-fragment perimeter and four empty wall bays visible as invented staging, with no official chamber insignia.
source:
**Frame:** The chair places the chapter's source packet into the center rather than a gavel.

**Dialogue — CHAIR:**
> We will separate what happened, what organizations say they changed, what has been tested, and what remains unknown.

**Provenance:** `invented` — organizing rule derived from the project truth contract.
title: A source packet replaces the gavel
